name: autostrefa_mx-mcp
description: Autos TREFA (automotive): search_listings, get_listing. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: GET /api/public/inventory (documented base https://trefa.mx/api/public, which now 301-redirects to autostrefa.mx) with marca, modelo, ano_min/ano_max, precio_min/precio_max (MXN), km_max, ubicacion (branch), page, per_page ≤ 100. Free text search is a separate endpoint (/inventory/search?q=) and `query` is not used here. The documented example names the year field `ano`; live rows carry `año`, which is what is mapped.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: GET /api/public/inventory/{slug or numeric id}: full vehicle (specs, prices and offers, image gallery, warranty and invoice info, financing estimates).
